description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), removes positive effects, grants [Awoken Seraph], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)] and [Dystopian Shift] to the user

description.name: Awoken Seraph
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Dark and Holy abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Cross Shift after using a Dark or Holy ability

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Dystopian Shift
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark] to the user after using two Holy or Dark abilities if the triggering ability dealt Holy/Dark damage
